subject: Customer Playbook & MAP starter kit — initial draft and slides
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@clearbay.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and timeline — can you share a MAP/playbook?

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Ledgerly is excited to run a short pilot focused on invoice parsing and expense categorization. Procurement wants a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) we can hand off internally (technical owners, timeline, acceptance criteria).

Can you share a MAP template you typically use and a quick slide deck we can present to our execs? Ideally the MAP includes:
- 30/60/90 milestones with owners
- Eval acceptance criteria (quality targets + performance SLOs)
- Security checkpoint (who to send questionnaire to)
- Procurement / PO timing and decision date

We aim to decide by Nov 12. Happy to tag in our security and procurement leads once we have a starter doc.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Donovan
Head of ML Ops, ClearBay (pilot partner for Ledgerly)
Attachments: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@clearbay.ai>, Matt Reynolds <matt.reynolds@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and timeline — attached MAP starter kit + slides

Claire / Matt — thanks, great to hear Ledgerly has a clear decision target. I've attached a compact MAP starter kit (Google Doc) and a 6-slide playbook you can hand to your execs. Highlights in the starter kit:

- One-page MAP summary with decision date, primary contacts, and success metrics
- 30/60/90 milestone rows (onboarding, model integration, perf tuning, acceptance)
- Go/No-go acceptance criteria (F1, throughput, privacy checklist) + explicit security gating
- Suggested meeting cadence (weekly sync + engineering checkpoints)
- Risk triggers (data access delay, infra incompatibility) and mitigation notes

Next steps I propose:
1) You share the names/emails for your security and procurement owners and I'll add them to the doc.
2) We set a 30-minute alignment call (this week) to lock owners and the decision date of Nov 12.

Drive links (edit):
- MAP starter kit (doc): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cRBWmap
- Executive playbook (slides): https://drive.google.com/open?id=5dE4X-slide

Attachments: rbw-map-starterkit-v1.gdoc, rbw-map-starterkit-v1.gslides

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and timeline — internal checklist before sending to customer

Looping internal owners — quick notes before we finalize the doc and slides to send: 

- Rishi: can you confirm recommended perf targets (tokens/sec + 95th pct latency) we should propose for the Ledgerly pilot? I put placeholders in the MAP.
- Monica: can your team take the security questionnaire once Claire tells us the contact? We'll need to provide SOC 2 summary, data retention, and KMS options.
- Vivek: pricing checkpoint — will this be a usage-based pilot or a reserved small commitment? Need quick guidance so the procurement team has numbers in the MAP.

I've attached Ledgerly's tech requirements they dropped in discovery (ledgerly-tech-requirements.pdf). Once Rishi and Monica sign off I'll push a v1 update back into the Drive folder and ask Claire to add their security/procurement contacts.

Attachments: ledgerly-tech-requirements.pdf

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@clearbay.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Reynolds <matt.reynolds@ledgerly.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and timeline — attached MAP starter kit + slides

Thanks Vivek — the starter kit looks good and the exec slide deck is concise. A couple of updates from our side: 

- Procurement contact: Matt Reynolds (matt.reynolds@ledgerly.com) — he'll own PO timing.
- Security contact: Priya Kannan (priya.kannan@ledgerly.com) — please send the Redwoods security questionnaire to her.
- Acceptance criteria: our desired thresholds are 92% classification F1 on our labeled test set, <200ms p95 latency at 50rps, and an agreed data retention policy of 30 days for raw payloads.
- Decision: Nov 12 still looks right, but we may need a short extension to Nov 16 if procurement needs more time.

Let's add the procurement and security contacts to the MAP doc. Can you also add a short line in the slides about expected total pilot spend (estimate) so procurement has a figure? Marissa / Vivek — can you confirm the expected pilot budget by EOD Monday?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Claire
Claire Donovan
Head of ML Ops, ClearBay
Attachments: none
